verse1.lyrics: First, when there's nothing but a slow glowing dream
That your fear seems to hide deep inside your mind
All alone I have cried silent tears full of pride
In a world made of steel, made of stone

pre-chorus1.lyrics: Well I hear the music, close my eyes, feel the rhythm
Wrap around, take a hold of my heart

chorus.chords: Bm A G A           Bm A G A

chorus.lyrics: I can't have it all, now I'm dancin' for my life

chorus.chords: Bm A G A              Bm A G A

chorus.lyrics: Take your passion,  and make it happen
Pictures come alive, you can dance right through your life

interlude.chords: D  A  Em  Bm  G  D  C  A

pre-chorus2.lyrics: Now I hear the music, close my eyes, I am rhythm
In a flash it takes hold of my heart
